subject: Adapt per-notebook feature engineering for category capability differences
description:
RESCOPED 2026-08-12 after F22. RTD is NOT missing data -- rtd_clean_facts_v has 2,409,362 rows in the live DB; our local parquet was 0x0 because the PULL FAILED. Brian re-ran save_all_datasets.py 2026-08-12. No supplier re-export needed.

DECISION LOCKED (Brian, 2026-08-12): no shared feature-engineering module. Danskvand having zero promotional measures makes a single shared path untenable; each category notebook adapts its own feature engineering.

Remaining work after the re-pull lands:

1. Re-verify schemas against the FRESH extract. The 15-vs-32 column gap for Danskvand was measured on the old snapshot -- confirm it persists (the DB may expose promo measures the old pull missed, exactly as it did for RTD).

2. Define the MINIMUM VIABLE COMPARISON: intersection of columns provably present in all four categories. This is the feature set for cross-category SRQ1 ranking "on identical data" and the only basis on which a POOLED model is defensible.

3. Define the OPTIMAL AVAILABLE set per category: every usable feature that category has. Better per-category accuracy, not comparable across categories, not poolable.

4. Per Brian: evaluate BOTH tracks -- 4+ model variants on the minimum viable set (plus optional pooled variant), and 4+ on the optimal available set. The delta quantifies what the promo family is worth: a genuine SRQ1 contribution.

5. POOLING TRAP (F21): product_id is NOT globally unique across categories (id 10 = FEVER TREE in CSD, EGEKILDE in Danskvand). A pooled dataset must key on (category, product_id) or drop product_id. Check brand-name collisions across categories before pooling on brand.

6. Energidrikke naming drift: weighted_distribution_disp_wo_feat / _feat_wo_disp vs CSD _disp_w_o_feat / _feat_w_o_disp. Normalise in per-notebook engineering.

Verify: written per-category capability matrix; minimum-viable column list with evidence; pooling key decision; two-track evaluation design recorded for Ch6.
